steps.why: An image build installs the rows of a package's record first: zig names cc and holds none of it, and the image has both.
steps.script: test -x /usr/bin/zig && echo '#include <stdio.h>' > /tmp/hello.c && echo 'int main(void) { puts("HELLO"); return 0; }' >> /tmp/hello.c && cc /tmp/hello.c -o /tmp/hello && test "$(/tmp/hello)" = HELLO

steps.why: cc is recorded before zig, and make, which cc installs, before cc.
steps.script: names=; while read row path pin; do names="$names ${path##*Dollyfile-}"; done < /etc/dolly/installed; test "$names" = ' core display make cc zig'
